sample.stable_id AS "${prefix}sampleId", patient.stable_id AS "${prefix}patientId", resource_sample.resource_id AS "${prefix}resourceId", cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier AS "${prefix}studyId"
, resource_sample.url AS "${prefix}url" , AS "${prefix}urlTemplate" , if(empty(resource_sample.url), resource_sample.metadata, NULL) AS "${prefix}metadata"
,

patient.stable_id AS "${prefix}patientId", resource_patient.resource_id AS "${prefix}resourceId", cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier AS "${prefix}studyId"
, resource_patient.url AS "${prefix}url" , AS "${prefix}urlTemplate" , if(empty(resource_patient.url), resource_patient.metadata, NULL) AS "${prefix}metadata"
,

resource_study.resource_id AS "${prefix}resourceId", cancer_study.cancer_study_identifier AS "${prefix}studyId"
, resource_study.url AS "${prefix}url" , AS "${prefix}urlTemplate" , if(empty(resource_study.url), resource_study.metadata, NULL) AS "${prefix}metadata"
,

(SELECT resource_id, cancer_study_id, any(url_template) AS template FROM resource_definition WHERE url_template IS NOT NULL AND url_template != '' GROUP BY resource_id, cancer_study_id) AS url_template_definition

FROM (SELECT resource_id, cancer_study_id, sample_id, url, metadata FROM resource WHERE resource_scope = 'SAMPLE' AND sample_id IS NOT NULL) AS resource_sample INNER JOIN cancer_study ON resource_sample.cancer_study_id = cancer_study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN sample ON sample.stable_id = resource_sample.sample_id INNER JOIN patient ON sample.patient_id = patient.internal_id AND patient.cancer_study_id = resource_sample.cancer_study_id
LEFT JOIN ON url_template_definition.resource_id = resource_sample.resource_id AND url_template_definition.cancer_study_id = resource_sample.cancer_study_id

FROM (SELECT resource_id, cancer_study_id, patient_id, url, metadata FROM resource WHERE resource_scope = 'PATIENT' AND patient_id IS NOT NULL) AS resource_patient INNER JOIN cancer_study ON resource_patient.cancer_study_id = cancer_study.cancer_study_id INNER JOIN patient ON patient.stable_id = resource_patient.patient_id AND patient.cancer_study_id = resource_patient.cancer_study_id
LEFT JOIN ON url_template_definition.resource_id = resource_patient.resource_id AND url_template_definition.cancer_study_id = resource_patient.cancer_study_id

FROM (SELECT resource_id, cancer_study_id, url, metadata FROM resource WHERE resource_scope = 'STUDY') AS resource_study INNER JOIN cancer_study ON resource_study.cancer_study_id = cancer_study.cancer_study_id
LEFT JOIN ON url_template_definition.resource_id = resource_study.resource_id AND url_template_definition.cancer_study_id = resource_study.cancer_study_id
